# HOW TO RETURN

If the purchase made does not meet your expectations, you have the option of making a return.

We will give you all the conditions and different options available so you can return your items.

### CONDITIONS TO COMPLETE A RETURN

* The return must be handled within the established period:
Online purchase: you have 30 days from the shipment date of your order.
Purchase at a store: you have 30 days from the purchase date.
* The items need to be in their original condition and with all their labels.
* You must make the return in the same market/region where you made the purchase.
You can find additional information about the Exchange and Return Policy or your right to withdrawal in our Conditions of use .
### RETURN AT A ZARA STORE

You can return items free of charge in any of our Zara stores.

In-store return is available for online purchases as well as those made in a physical store. You just have to present the items to return and your Zara QR or the receipt.

Use our store locator to find your nearest Zara store.
### RETURN AT A DROP OFF POINT

You can return your items by leaving your package at a delivery point.

The cost per return request is $ 4.95 which will be subtracted from your refund.

If you made the purchase as a registered user, you can request the return in the Returns section of your account.

If you have made your purchase as a guest, you can request a return by clicking the "Manage Your Order" link in any of your order or shipment confirmation emails.
Once you have requested the return, we will email you the instructions to make the delivery and the number of labels to match the number of packages you are going to send.

Follow the instructions and take the return to the location of the shipping company you indicated to us that you want to use.

This option is available only for online purchases.

You do not need to include the receipt.
When making a return request, if your order contains a large sized item from the HOME collection, we will ask you to contact us to arrange a pickup at your house.
## Frequently Asked Questions

### HOW DO I NEED TO PREPARE MY RETURN PACKAGE?

If you no longer have the original packaging, you can return your order in any other packaging provided that it is properly sealed to prevent the items getting lost. You do not have to write a delivery address on the package.

You do not need to include the receipt.
### HOW DO I ACCESS MY RETURN LABEL?

You can access the return label whenever you like in the Returns section of your account. If you made the purchase as a guest, log in via the link included in any of the emails related to your order.
### DO I NEED TO PRINT THE RETURN LABEL TO BE ABLE TO DEPOSIT MY ORDER AT A DELIVERY POINT?

If you have received the return label you must print it to be able to take your order to the drop off point. On the contrary, if you have received a barcode or QR code, you do not have to print it, just follow the instructions in the adjoining email.
### CAN I RETURN ITEMS FROM DIFFERENT ORDERS IN A SINGLE SHIPMENT?

Remember you can return items from different orders in the same shipment. Select all the items you want to return independently from their order numbers and continue the return request procedure through completion. Remember that during the procedure you should indicate the number of packages you will need for your return.
### HOW CAN I RETURN AN ONLINE ORDER MADE FROM A STORE?

The way to return an online order made from the store depends on your payment method:

* If you have paid for your order at the store register and you want to make a return, you will have to visit a Zara store to complete it.

# RETURN REFUND

Once we have handled the return of your items, we will continue with the refund.

REFUND OF IN-STORE PURCHASE

If you have returned an item purchased in-store, the refund will be made with the same method of payment used for the purchase.

If a refund to the original method of payment is not possible, our store staff will indicate an alternative method.

REIMBURSEMENT OF AN ONLINE PURCHASE
When you make a return of an online purchase, you will receive the refund via the same payment method you used for the purchase.

If you sent your return through a shipping company, we will process it in the 72 hours after receiving it in our facilities.

Once the return has been completed we will send you a confirmation email.

Keep in mind that once the return has been made, you will receive the amount within a maximum period of 14 days, depending on your bank.
If you do not see a credit to your account within 14 days, please use this confirmation and present it to your banking institution so they may help you facilitate the process.

You can find additional information about the Exchange and Return Policy or your right to withdrawal in our Terms and Conditions .
## Frequently Asked Questions

### WHY HAVE I NOT RECEIVED MY REFUND CONFIRMATION EMAIL?

If you have not received the email with the information from your refund, please check that the email address associated with your account is correct.

Keep in mind that if you make a return through a delivery point, it will be processed once the items arrive at our facilities. Once completed, you will receive an email with the return information.
### I NO LONGER HAVE THE CARD I USED TO MAKE THE PURCHASE. HOW CAN I RECEIVE MY REFUND?

The refund will always be handled via same payment method used for the order. If you do not have the card used for the purchase available we suggest you contact your bank so they can assist you.
### I NO LONGER HAVE THE GIFT CARD I USED TO PAY. HOW WILL I RECEIVE MY REFUND?

If the return is for an online purchase, together with the confirmation email for the return, you will receive a virtual copy of that card with the updated balance.

If you make the return from a purchase made in-store, our store staff will issue the refund on a Gift Card or on any other Gift Card you may have.
### WHY DID I RECEIVE A PARTIAL REFUND FROM MY RETURN?

Keep in mind that, should you send us your items in different packages, we may issue the refund at different times. We will send you an email confirmation with the detail of each one.

If you prefer, you can contact us so we can review your case in detail.
### HOW CAN I GET THE INVOICE FOR MY REFUND?

You can access your reimbursement invoice through your order detail. If you made the purchase without registering, you can do it from the link found in your return confirmation email.

# HOW TO MAKE AN EXCHANGE

At Zara we give you the option of changing items from your purchase for free. We will explain the conditions to you and how to handle it.

### CONDITIONS TO COMPLETE AN EXCHANGE

* The exchange must be handled within the established period:
Online purchase: you have 30 days from the shipment date of your order.
Purchase at a store: you have 30 days from the purchase date.
* The items need to be in their original condition and with all their labels.
* You must make the exchange in the same market/region where you made the purchase.
You can request an exchange online for items from MASSIMO DUTTI. Exchanges cannot be made for items from HOME.

You can find additional information about the Exchange and Return Policy or your right to withdrawal in our Terms and Conditions .
### EXCHANGE IN A ZARA STORE

If you have purchased an item in-store or online, we give you the option of exchanging it for another size or color at any of our stores.

To exchange an online order, you do not have to request a return beforehand.

Locate the store nearest you using our store locator .
### ONLINE EXCHANGE

If you purchased an item online, you have the option of exchanging a size or color through our website or app.

The process is very easy: just select the items to exchange and the size or color you would like to receive. The selected items will be sent in a new order and you will have to return those you no longer want. We offer various options that you can consult in the How to make a return section.
The return period for the merchandise you do not want is 14 days from the exchange request. If this period has passed and we have not received the items indicated to be exchanged, you will be charged the amount of the new items via the payment method used for the purchase.

If you want to modify or cancel your exchange request, please contact us so we can help manage this process.
## Frequently Asked Questions
### WHEN CAN I NOT REQUEST AN ONLINE EXCHANGE?

In the situations listed below, it is not possible to request an online exchange, but you can always visit one of our stores to complete the process.
* The online exchange option is not available for orders paid via: Paypal, Ideal, Bancontact, Diners Club, P24, gift card, ApplePay and AndroidPay (some of these payment methods may not be available in your market/region).
* The exchange option will not be available if the item purchased is one size fits all or if it is no longer available.
* Online exchanges are not available for purchases that include a gift receipt. You always have the option to make an exchange in-store or a return.
* Only two exchange requests can be made at a time, with a maximum of 5 items per request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### WHEN WILL I BE CHARGED FOR MY ORDER?

The charge will take place once your order is shipped. If you paid with Paypal or a Gift Card, it will go through immediately once the purchase is completed.

### HOW CAN I PAY WITH A GIFT CARD?

If you received a Gift Card from us from a return with the amount of the refund, you can use it to place an order. You have to select “Gift Card” as the method of payment and enter the corresponding numbers.
### CAN I APPLY A DISCOUNT CODE TO MY PURCHASE?

At Zara we don’t have discount codes. Subscribe to our Newsletter to stay up to date on all our promotions.

### CAN I PAY FOR MY PURCHASES IN INSTALLMENTS?

Payment terms depend on the conditions associated with the card you used to make the purchase.
### I HAVE BEEN CHARGED TWICE FOR THE PURCHASE AMOUNT. WHAT CAN I DO?

Some banking institutions may withhold a pre-authorization and an actual charge. This amount will automatically be deleted. If that is not the case, we recommend that you contact your bank so they may expedite removal of the pre-authorization withholding amount.
### HOW DO I PAY FOR AN ONLINE ORDER MADE FROM A STORE?

At the time of purchase our store staff will inform you of the available options in that store to pay for your order:

* From the device you used to make the purchase.
* At the store register. You have two hours to make the payment. If you do not pay at the register, the order will be canceled.

Keep in mind that the availability of these options can vary depending on the Zara store you visit.

# SHIPPING METHODS, TIMES AND PRICING

The shipping options may vary based on the delivery address, the time you place your order, and availability of items.

At the time of processing your order, we will show you the shipping methods available, the charges and the estimated delivery date.

Please remember that deliveries are only made on business days.

Remember that the delivery address of your order has to be in the same market/region where you made the purchase.
### SHIPMENT TO A ZARA STORE

Time: 3-5 working days

Cost: FREE

At the time of placing the order we will show you the stores available and the estimated delivery date.

You have 15 days to pick up the order at the store. You only need to present your ZARA QR or the QR code from the electronic receipt. If someone else comes in your place, they must also show their identification card.

Use our store locator to find your nearest Zara store.
This option is not available for orders that include a large item from our HOME collection.
### HOME DELIVERY

* Next day delivery - $ 14.95 or $ 19.95 (depending on delivery address). $ 25.00 only for Alaska and Hawaii.
* Delivery in 2-4 working days - $ 4.95

Please keep in mind if your order includes a large item from HOME, corresponding shipping costs will be charged.

If you made your purchase as a registered user, you can change the delivery address by accessing your order details in your account ; should it still be possible per the status of your order.
### SHIPMENT TO A DELIVERY POINT

Period: 2-4 working days

Cost: $ 4.95

When you complete your purchase we will show you the available delivery points and the estimated date you will receive your order.

We will let you know when your order is available at the selected delivery point. Remember that you will need to provide identification to be able to pick it up. If another person comes in your place, they will need to present written authorization and a copy of your identification document.
This option is not available for orders that include a large item from our HOME collection.
## Frequently Asked Questions

### WHEN WILL I RECEIVE MY ORDER?

When placing the order, we will provide you with the estimated delivery date. Then you can track it from your account or, if you purchased as a guest, from the link in any of the emails we have sent you about your purchase.

### CAN I CHANGE THE SHIPPING METHOD?

If the purchase has been finalized, the selected shipping method cannot be changed.
### WHAT HAPPENS IF MY ORDER COULD NOT BE DELIVERED?

If you have selected home delivery and you are absent at the time of delivery, we suggest that you contact us and we will revise it with the shipping company.

### CAN I DECLINE DELIVERY OF MY ORDER?

If you no longer want to receive your purchase, we suggest you contact us so we can manage it.
### CAN I DELAY MY ORDER?

If we were not able to deliver your order on the estimated date, we will send you an email and you can see the new delivery date in the order detail.
### MY ORDER SHOWS AS BEING DELIVERED BUT I HAVE NOT RECEIVED IT. WHAT CAN I DO?

Sometimes a delivered package can be misplaced or received by someone else at your address. Please follow these steps to help locate your order:
* Wait 72 hours: Occasionally, couriers mark packages as delivered a bit early. Please wait 72 hours from the ‘delivered’ status before reporting it as missing.
* Check around and track your order: Look in all possible delivery locations, including mailrooms and with neighbors or building staff who might have accepted it on your behalf. Also, we recommend you to use the tracking number found in your shipping confirmation email or in your account order details. You can often find the courier’s proof of delivery there too.
* Contact the courier: In many cases, the courier can provide more details or help locate the package.
* Still missing? If you can’t locate your package after 72 hours and the courier is unable to help, please contact our customer service team.
### I BOUGHT A LARGE ITEM FROM ZARA HOME. HOW WILL IT BE DELIVERED?

The product will remain packed until it is delivered to the room of your choice.

We will contact you to check the measurements of the delivery space and inform you of the dimensions of the packaging of these items.

In the event of a crane service being necessary to make the delivery, we will assist you with its managing according to its availability. The cost will not be included in the shipping costs applied during the purchase.

# SPECIAL RETURN CONDITIONS

Some of our items, due to their unique characteristics, must meet the following conditions in order to be returned or exchanged:
* Swimwear: must include the hygiene strip.
* Undergarments:
Woman: undergarments may be exchanged or returned provided they are in the same condition as when purchased and retain the protective bag or sticker with which they were sent to you.

Kids: undergarments cannot be returned or exchanged with the exception of socks, tights, tops, bodysuits, and undershirts that are still in their original packaging.
* Accessories: must be returned with their original bag or cardboard intact.
* Fragrances: Must be returned in the original sealed packaging.
* Cosmetics: the item must be returned unused, sealed and in its original packaging Items from the Standard Procedure collection may not be exchanged or returned.
* Personalized items: due to the custom nature of these items, returns and exchanges are not permitted.
* HOME items must be returned in their sealed original packaging and in its original condition.
* Packs: items that are part of a pack cannot be returned separately.
* Special packaging and additional accessories: the items that arrive with special packaging (fabric bags, special boxes, garment bags...) or that contain additional accessories must be returned with them and in their original condition.
* Magazines: They cannot be returned.

# COMPOSITION AND CARE

At Zara, you will find a wide range of products made of natural, artificial and synthetic materials. You can find detailed information about the composition of each item at both Zara.com and in our traditional stores.
Our Sustainability Policy also includes the obligation that all our products of animal origin come from animals that are treated ethically and responsibly, and in no case from animals slaughtered exclusively for the sale of their skins, shells, feathers or down, among others.

We are working with monitoring programs to guarantee compliance with the social, environmental, and health and safety standards of our garments.
We have a traceability system that allows us to monitor the supply chain of our productions. We ask our suppliers to inform us about all the facilities involved in the production processes, from the yarn or fiber to the final garment. This includes both own and external factories, as well as the intermediaries involved in each process. To assess its compliance, we have developed an audit program and plans for continual improvement.

Please visit our Join Life section for more information.
CARE RECOMMENDATIONS

For each product, both on the website as well as on our garment labels, you will find information about the best way to care for your garments.

Also, we created a guide that will help you care for your garments and lengthen their useful life. Visit Care for your clothing for more information.

# WHAT'S MY SIZE?

At Zara we offer a wide range of sizes that can vary according to the style, cut and fabric of each garment. So you can select the size that will best fit you, we have two tools for you to use, our measurement guide and the Find your size option.

MEASUREMENT GUIDE

You can find our measurement guide on the product page. Select the size you want and we will show you what body measurements it is tailored to.

FIND YOUR SIZE
To assist you in your size selection, we suggest you use the Find your size option, available on each item’s page. We will calculate which size is best for you through this tool, based on information you provide (your body measurements and how you like your clothes to fit).
## Frequently Asked Questions

### HOW CAN I CHECK WHAT AN ITEM’S MEASUREMENTS ARE?

If you want to know the measurements of any item you can check our measurement guide. If you do not find the measurement you need, contact us so we can help you.
